newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Malaysia's AMMB to set $100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's AMMB to set $100 mln FRCD.

text.p: AMMB International (Labuan) Ltd has mandated Societe Generale Asia to arrange a US$100 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said on Tuesday.
The deal is guaranteed by Arab-Malaysian Merchant Bank Bhd.
The issue has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options. It will be priced at par to float at 25 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is around 28 to 30 basis points.
An underwriting and arrangers group is being formed.
